name: VanoLib Reader
description: Read PDFs in the VanoLib reader: sharp text, day / sepia / night, search, outline, highlights, citation cards, a reading list kept offline, one-click download, verified references (Crossref / arXiv), the exact statement behind a citation like [May25, Lemma 2.1], a research panel (cited by, related papers, .bib export), full-text search of your library, Overleaf integration (open the compiled PDF in VanoLib, citation cards in the preview), and sending to your VanoAtlas library.
